title: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomic dissection of tumor-associated macrophage heterogeneity in cervical cancer: multi-omics perspectives and immunotherapy resistance.
snippet: Tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) exhibit profound phenotypic and functional heterogeneity in cervical carcinoma, acting as key regulators of disease progression, extracellular matrix remodeling, and primary resistance to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB).
